description: Nested Cx::masked (cx.rs:3315) on a cancelled task while its parent waits on its join (bd-9kll.3.19). t.w is cancelled (User, at 50) while it waits on n.go; woken at 100, it nests three masks. Every checkpoint inside them passes, including those after an inner mask is released (the outer ones still hold), and is_cancel_requested sees the request. Only once the outermost mask ends does the next checkpoint acknowledge the cancel (ASX_E_CANCELLED), which ends t.w's program. A spawned child that acknowledges its cancel after its first poll keeps its own result (SpawnCompletionPolicy::PreserveAcknowledgedCancellationResult, cx.rs:4901), so t.main's join observes Ok.
